claim.summary: If a tail coordinate list already has a bundled coordinate-envelope checklist and a new head coordinate satisfies the same pointwise residual and positive-gap bounds, then the cons-extended list has a checklist and shifted dominance for every coordinate.
claim.tail_certificate: CoordinateEnvelopeChecklist c a b B δ coords
claim.constructed_certificate: CoordinateEnvelopeChecklist c a b B δ (p :: coords)
claim.conclusion: forall q in p :: coords, shiftedSqMod c q.1 q.2 < shiftedSqMod c a b

proves: cons checklist evidence implies shifted dominance for the extended finite list
does_not_prove: that any coordinate is an eigenvalue
that the coordinate list is a matrix spectrum
actual spectrum extraction from a matrix
construction of B from a matrix spectrum
construction of δ from a matrix spectral gap
strict spectral-abscissa hypothesis for a matrix eigenvalue
that a strict-abscissa eigenvalue of a real matrix is real
